description: GCS object-name percent-encoding for the data-files `files` SDK. The SDK must percent-encode the full object name (KEELSON_FILES_PREFIX + key): '/' as %2F so each key is a single flat object (never a nested GCS path), space as %20, and non-ASCII as UTF-8 %XX. All three SDKs must (a) store exactly `object_name` after write(`key`), and (b) emit `encoded_object` on the request URL, proving that '/' is percent-encoded on the wire rather than passed through.
